patch_description: Replace the geometric-mean relay affinity with an affinity that gives credit to both legs while retaining more influence from the stronger leg: `min(left, right) + 0.25 * max(left, right)`. This tests the suggested balanced-leg criterion without changing relay pressure discounts, candidate ranking, per-OD relay budgets, or quadratic weights. It may favor relays whose links are jointly useful while still recognizing a strong leg when the other leg is weaker.
